stem: A suspect drying rack shows an unusual product condition. What is the strongest first action?
choices: Protect the rack under the authorized hold/segregation process and document identity, location, time and observations before assigning cause.
Blend the material into unaffected racks.
Release it because no cause is confirmed.
Declare the entire facility affected immediately.
rationale: Protect the rack under the authorized hold/segregation process and document identity, location, time and observations before assigning cause.
